description: Lists Managed Nerds' fixed-scope projects as JSON, such as business email, domains, Wi-Fi, Google Business Profile and websites. Each entry says who it's for and isn't, what's included, what the buyer provides, the typical timeline, whether it's one-time or ongoing, and the questions a quote needs. Every project is quoted by a person; no prices. A project quote is requested with request_service (service_line project). Managed IT and security services are listed by list_services and guides by list_guides.
